title: AP Labs client profile
description: Declares one client's inputs to the kit. Lives at .aplabs/profile.yml in the client repo; its presence marks the repo as governed. Unknown keys are errors.

tiers.description: Blast radius (PR-01). Highest matching tier wins; unmatched code floors at T1.

inert.description: Paths that floor at T0. A change is T0 only when every path is inert.

exempt.description: Paths the write gate never applies to.

resources.description: What can be granted. Keys are referenced by users[].grants and users[].deny.

admin_grantable.description: false = the admin role does not confer it; it needs an explicit grant.

open_access.description: true = allowed for everyone, including people not in users. A user's deny still wins.

users.description: Who can do what (PR-03: deny beats allow). The only access source.

stages.description: Add-on stages the client switches on. Each slots between two core stages and never removes one.

forbidden_columns.description: Columns no query may name, as lower-case "table.column". While any is set, wildcards and whole-row references are refused too. Default: none.

data.description: Where the bot reads its data (kit/runtime/data). source: local (default; the built fixture file) or motherduck (the one MotherDuck database named by database, read with MOTHERDUCK_READ_TOKEN). database is required for motherduck and refused for local.

database.description: A plain lower-case name, not MotherDuck's own my_db or sample_data and not a fixture:publish staging copy (*__publishing).

jobs.description: Scheduled jobs (kit/runtime/jobs, <app>/jobs.json). enabled: true lets the app run the jobs its jobs.json enables; default false. APLABS_JOBS_OFF (any non-empty value) turns every job off whatever this says.

slack.description: Slack settings (kit/runtime). ops_channel: the channel id a failed push is escalated to (module, reason and counts only, never client data; AD-14). Optional, no default: unset, an escalation is only logged. Invite the bot to the channel; chat:write covers it. A channel id, never a secret.

llm.description: The AI helper (kit/runtime/llm). All optional. model and extraction_model must be priced in kit/runtime/llm/prices.js (boot refuses one that is not); default claude-sonnet-5-5. hourly_usd_limit caps this process's estimated AI spend in any hour, in US dollars (default 2). max_tokens caps each reply (default 1024). The key is never set here.

run.description: argv array, spawned without a shell. argv[0] is the executable.

timeout_seconds.description: The check is killed and recorded as timeout after this long. Default 300.

env_allow.description: Extra parent env var names passed to checks, on top of the fixed allowlist. Nothing else reaches a check.
